output.explanation: A row passes if it has no report_date. If it has one, visit_date must be present, must not be after report_date, and must be no more than 10 days (240 hours) before it.
fails_when: report_date is present but visit_date is null.
report_date is more than 10 days (240 hours) after visit_date.

Surprising: the expression adds the text "T00:00:00Z" to report_date and visit_date, which are declared as dates (NAIVE_DATE), not strings. If the engine doesn't convert dates to text for this, the check may raise an error or fail on every row that has a report_date, instead of giving a real answer.
passes_when: report_date is null, whatever visit_date is.
report_date is present, visit_date is present, and visit_date is on or before report_date.
The gap between visit_date and report_date is 10 days or less. Exactly 10 days passes, and the same day passes.
